ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure there are two synchronously triggered JK flip-flops, the output of the left flip-flop is labeled Q1 and Q1 complement, and the output of the right flip-flop is labeled Q2 and Q2 complement; both are driven by the same CLK clock. The feedback connections in the figure give: after substituting the inputs of the 1st flip-flop, it satisfies Q1+ = (Q2 complement)(Q1 complement) + (Q2 complement)Q1; after substituting the inputs of the 2nd flip-flop, it satisfies Q2+ = Q1(Q2 complement) + Q1Q2. Then reason: the characteristic equation of a JK flip-flop is Q+ = J·Q complement + K complement·Q. Substituting according to the connections in the figure, simplifying gives Q1+ = Q2 complement, Q2+ = Q1. The initial state Q1Q2 = 00. Iterate clock by clock: 00 -> 10 -> 11 -> 01 -> 00 -> .... Therefore reading Q1 starting from the initial state gives 0, 1, 1, 0, 0, ...
